parsed.post: The latest experiment (0.840991) improved upon my previous best (0.843226). It seems the current combination of DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.03 is performing well. I will now try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if a different geometric capacity helps reduce bits per byte.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to explore if a different architectural geometry improves representation capacity.
